# Yogurt

> Yogurt is a free, open-source desktop app for private AI meeting notes. It records your calls without adding a bot to the meeting, transcribes them on your computer and writes a summary. It is an alternative to Granola, made by Frigade and released under the MIT license.

Yogurt runs on macOS 14.4 or newer (Apple silicon), Windows 10 version 2004 or newer (x64) and Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, x64 AppImage). It needs at least 8 GB of memory. It is free and needs no account.

How it works: Yogurt records your microphone and the sound playing on your computer. Speech is transcribed with whisper.cpp and, on supported Macs, Apple SpeechAnalyzer. A local open-weight model running through llama.cpp writes the summary and answers questions. Audio, transcripts and AI processing stay on your computer; Yogurt goes online to download models and check for updates. No bot joins the call, so people on the call should be told it is being recorded.

What it does: live transcripts; meeting summaries that include your own notes; speaker names from Zoom, Teams and Meet; a multi-language mode that transcribes 99 languages; questions across meetings with links to the source; folders and search; copy and Markdown export; and an optional local MCP server that lets apps on your computer read your notes, transcripts, saved audio and each meeting's calendar details.

## Website

- [Yogurt](https://yogurt.so/): what Yogurt is, a demo, and downloads for Mac, Windows and Linux
- [Updates](https://yogurt.so/updates): every release with what changed, in plain words

## Download

- [Mac](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-mac-arm64.dmg): Apple silicon, macOS 14.4 or newer. With Homebrew: `brew install --cask frigadehq/yogurt/yogurt`
- [Windows](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-windows-x64.exe): Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, x64
- [Linux](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-linux-x86_64.AppImage): AppImage for Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, x64
- [All releases](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases)
